purpose: Classify Phase 2 turn-service holdouts for future sealed-release eligibility. Consumed or unsuitable sets must not be reused as fresh sealed evidence.

labels.consumed: Already used in a sealed evaluation that passed; do not reuse for future sealed-release claims.
labels.historical: Superseded archival artifact kept for lineage; not eligible as a fresh sealed release set.
labels.unsuitable: Failed sealed run or otherwise unfit; do not cite for sealed-release claims.
labels.sealed_pending_run: Fresh sealed candidate awaiting an independent evaluation run.

holdouts.notes: Original v1 holdout; failed sealed attempt and superseded by later versions. Marked non-sealed for future release eligibility.
